name: IBlogExtensibility
description: An object that provides the ability to manipulate blog entries.

methods.name: BlogProviderProperties
methods.signature: BlogProviderProperties(BlogProvider As String, FriendlyName As String, CategorySupport As MsoBlogCategorySupport, Padding As Boolean)

parameters.name: BlogProvider
parameters.description: The name of the blog provider.

parameters.name: FriendlyName
parameters.description: Represents the name displayed in the user interface.

parameters.name: CategorySupport
parameters.description: Represents how many categories are supported by the provider.

parameters.name: Padding
parameters.description: Specifies whether table padding is recognized.

methods.name: SetupBlogAccount
methods.signature: SetupBlogAccount(Account As String, ParentWindow As Long, Document As Object, NewAccount As Boolean, ShowPictureUI As Boolean)
methods.description: Called from the Choose Account dialog when the provider's name is chosen in the Blog Host drop-down, or when the user requests to change a provider's account in the Blog Accounts dialog box.

parameters.name: Account
parameters.description: Represents the GUID of the account registry key. Blog account settings are stored in the registry at \\HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Office\Common\Blog\Account.

parameters.name: ParentWindow
parameters.description: Contains the HWND for the window that Microsoft Word is calling from.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: The current document.

parameters.name: NewAccount
parameters.description: Indicates whether this is a new account.

parameters.name: ShowPictureUI
parameters.description: Indicates whether Word's picture user interface needs to be displayed.

methods.name: GetUserBlogs
methods.signature: GetUserBlogs(Account As String, ParentWindow As Long, Document As Object, BlogNames As SAFEARRAY(String), BlogIDs As SAFEARRAY(String), BlogURLs As SAFEARRAY(String))
methods.description: Returns the list and details of user blogs associated with the specified account.

parameters.name: Account
parameters.description: Represents the GUID of the account registry key. Blog account settings are stored in the registry at \\HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Office\Common\Blog\Account.

parameters.name: ParentWindow
parameters.description: Contains the HWND for the window that Microsoft Word is calling from.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: The current document.

methods.name: GetRecentPosts
methods.signature: GetRecentPosts(Account As String, ParentWindow As Long, Document As Object, PostTitles As SAFEARRAY(String), PostDates As SAFEARRAY(String), PostIDs As SAFEARRAY(String))
methods.description: Returns the list of the user's last fifteen blog posts that Microsoft Word then displays in the Open Existing Post dialog. This method does not actually return the blog post contents.

parameters.name: Account
parameters.description: Represents the GUID of the account registry key. Blog account settings are stored in the registry at \\HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Office\Common\Blog\Account.

parameters.name: ParentWindow
parameters.description: Contains the HWND for the window that Microsoft Word is calling from.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: The current document.

methods.name: Open
methods.signature: Open(Account As String, PostID As String, ParentWindow As Long, xHTML As String, Title As String, DatePosted As String, Categories As SAFEARRAY(String))
methods.description: Opens the blog specified by the blog ID. It's called by the Open Existing Post dialog based on the item selected by the user.

parameters.name: Account
parameters.description: Represents the GUID of the account registry key. Blog account settings are stored in the registry at \\HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Office\Common\Blog\Account.

parameters.name: PostID
parameters.description: The ID of the post.

parameters.name: ParentWindow
parameters.description: Contains the HWND for the window that Microsoft Word is calling from.

parameters.name: xHTML
parameters.description: Represents the xHTML of the current document.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: The title of the post.

parameters.name: DatePosted
parameters.description: The date the entry was posted.

methods.name: PublishPost
methods.signature: PublishPost(Account As String, ParentWindow As Long, Document As Object, xHTML As String, Title As String, DateTime As String, Categories As SAFEARRAY(String), Draft As Boolean, PostID As String, PublishMessage As String)
methods.description: Hands off the current post so that it can be published by the provider.

parameters.name: Account
parameters.description: Represents the GUID of the account registry key. Blog account settings are stored in the registry at \\HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Office\Common\Blog\Account.

parameters.name: ParentWindow
parameters.description: Contains the HWND for the window that Microsoft Word is calling from.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: The current document.

parameters.name: xHTML
parameters.description: Represents the xHTML of the current document.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: The title of the post.

parameters.name: DateTime
parameters.description: The date the entry was posted.

parameters.name: Draft
parameters.description: Specifies whether this is a draft version of the post.

parameters.name: PostID
parameters.description: The ID of the original post if this post has been republished.

parameters.name: PublishMessage
parameters.description: Specifies what is displayed in the publish bar.

methods.name: RepublishPost
methods.signature: RepublishPost(Account As String, ParentWindow As Long, Document As Object, PostID As String, xHTML As String, Title As String, DateTime As String, Categories As SAFEARRAY(String), Draft As Boolean, PublishMessage As String)

methods.name: GetCategories
methods.signature: GetCategories(Account As String, ParentWindow As Long, Document As Object, Categories As SAFEARRAY(String))
methods.description: This method returns the list of blog categories for an account so that Microsoft Word can populate the categories drop-down list.
